hero_background.usage: Optional subtle background overlay with low opacity (10%)

data_flow.usage: Use in the processing state or success card background

general: Strictly follow the Dark Mode aesthetic. Do not use white backgrounds.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all headings (h1-h6). Use 'Inter' for body text.
Implement the File Upload as a large, central drag-and-drop zone in the Hero section.
The 'Process' button should be prominent and trigger a loading state with a progress bar.
Results should appear below the upload zone using a 'Bento Grid' layout: Summary (Large Card) + Action Items (Table Card).
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (min 4.5:1).
Use 'lucide-react' for icons (e.g., UploadCloud, FileText, CheckCircle, Download).
For the Action Items table, ensure columns: Assignee, Action, Due Date are clearly visible.
file_handling: Implement a 'Paste Text' tab alternative to file upload.
Mock the processing delay (2-3 seconds) with a smooth progress bar animation.
animations: Add hover effects to all cards (subtle border glow).
Animate the appearance of results (Framer Motion: fade-in + slide-up).
Smooth transitions for tab switching (Upload vs Paste).

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
